notes.title: Notice regarding release of update data
notes.notes:
An update has been released today.
(Additional features regarding autosave and other minor fixes)

Regarding the problem discovered in the Steam version that was causing “save”, “autosave” and “quick save” to fail, we have added the following features:

・When a save fails, you can now choose to continue the game instead of going back to the title screen.
・Added an autosave ON/OFF toggle in Config.
　(If saves fail frequently, please turn autosave OFF)

Also, saves may fail if the save location is set to the Cloud, so changing the save location is recommended.

Thank you for continuing to support SaGa Frontier Remastered.
